Summarise what changed in 3.4 for the release note. {/* ghost is the only variant with no frame and no 80% cap, so a structured answer uses the whole row. */} {/* * Real elements, not a markdown renderer, so nothing sets raw HTML from * a string. The block layout sits on this wrapper because ChatBubbleContent * owns its own padding, radius and font size. */}

3.4 is a reliability release. Nothing in it changes an API, and three fixes are worth naming in the note.

What changed

  • Refund webhooks retry for up to a minute, so a{' '} charge.refunded event no longer drops when the processor is slow.
  • Group membership stays in step with the identity provider, including removals that used to need a manual resync.
  • CSV exports finish at every accepted size.
{/* The long tail folds away so the answer reads at a glance. */}

Why the webhooks dropped

The payments worker retried a batch of 1,200 deliveries after a processor timeout, and each retry opened a connection of its own until the pool hit its ceiling.

We raised the pool to 60 and capped the worker at 8 concurrent deliveries. A backoff follows in 3.5.

Everything else is unchanged.{' '} Open the full diff
